entities.summary: Coordinated terrorist attacks by al-Qaeda on September 11, 2001, killing nearly 3,000 people. The attacks fundamentally reshaped US foreign policy, global security frameworks, and led to wars in Afghanistan (2001) and Iraq (2003).
